recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Any future changes to questionnaire-display-category or questionnaire-item-control should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than by reintroducing retired core terminology source files.
issue_request: FHIR-24117 was a Published FHIR-core Questionnaire change request, resolved Persuasive, asking to resolve overlap between questionnaire-display-category and questionnaire-item-control help codes by removing help from display-category.
initial_application: Core commit 17fa4f6e5e deleted the help concept from source/questionnaire/codesystem-questionnaire-display-category.xml. That reversed the earlier FHIR-17208/GF#17208 placement of help in display-category while leaving questionnaire-item-control help available.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 later removed the Questionnaire extension and terminology artifacts from the core checkout. Current core fhir.ini still lists Questionnaire as active but has no active questionnaire-display-category artifact entry; current core only references the canonical in examples/conversion helpers. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains the authoritative questionnaire-display-category and questionnaire-item-control definitions. Its display-category CodeSystem has instructions, security, and legal only, while item-control still includes help. Zulip discussions around FHIR-24117 and later displayCategory use support itemControl=help for help-button behavior, and Confluence searches found no conflicting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because the source-changing part of the issue was already applied and the remaining authoritative artifacts are outside the FHIR core checkout and already correct.

related_jiras.note: Originally added help to questionnaire-display-category; FHIR-24117 later reversed that placement because itemControl already carried the help UI-control meaning.
Added legal to both display-category and item-control; it is already represented on the combined branch and confirms the moved Extension Pack artifacts are the current source of truth.
Corrected questionnaire-displayCategory context to apply to display items, but did not reintroduce display-category help.
